// (2) Мы переименовали Event в GameEvent, чтобы браузер не ругался
class GameEvent {
constructor(type, power = 50) {
this.type = type;
// Заменили EVENTS на EVENT_DATA
this.data = EVENT_DATA[type.toUpperCase().replace(" ", "_")] || EVENT_DATA.FLOOR_COLOR;
this.startTime = Date.now();
this.duration = CONFIG.EVENTS.DURATION * (power / 50);
this.endTime = this.startTime + this.duration;
this.power = power;
this.isActive = true;
this.applyEffect();
this.showEventStart();
}
// ... остальной код класса
update() {
if (Date.now() > this.endTime) {
this.isActive = false;
this.removeEffect();
return false;
}
return true;
}
applyEffect() {
const powerMultiplier = this.power / 50;
switch (this.type) {
case "floorColor":
const colors = CONFIG.EVENTS.COLORS;
floorColor = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
break;
case "rainbowFood":
foods.forEach((food) => {
food.color = "rainbow";
});
break;
case "speedBoost":
if (player) {
player.speedMultiplier = 1 + 0.5 * powerMultiplier;
}
bots.forEach((bot) => {
    if (!bot.isBanned) {
        // Проверяем расстояние до игрока
        const dSq = player.pos.distSq(bot.pos);
        
        // Если бот очень далеко (вне экрана и запаса), обновляем его в 2 раза реже
        if (dSq > 4000000) { // Примерно 2000 пикселей
            if (frameCounter % 2 === 0) {
                bot.isActive = true;
                bot.update(deltaTime);
            }
        } else {
            bot.isActive = true;
            bot.update(deltaTime);
        }
    }
});
break;
case "apocalypse":
for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
const distance = 300 + Math.random() * 200;
const x = (player ? player.pos.x : CONFIG.WORLD_SIZE / 2) + Math.cos(angle) * distance;
const y = (player ? player.pos.y : CONFIG.WORLD_SIZE / 2) + Math.sin(angle) * distance;
zombies.push(new Zombie(x, y));
}
break;
}
}
removeEffect() {
switch (this.type) {
case "floorColor":
floorColor = "#0a1a2a";
break;
case "rainbowFood":
foods.forEach((food) => {
food.color = CONFIG.FOOD.COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * CONFIG.FOOD.COLORS.length)];
});
break;
case "speedBoost":
if (player) {
player.speedMultiplier = 1;
}
bots.forEach((bot) => {
if (bot.isAlive && !bot.isBanned) {
bot.speedMultiplier = 1;
}
});
break;
case "invisibility":
if (player) {
player.isInvisible = false;
}
break;
case "xpBoost":
CONFIG.ORBS.VALUE = 2;
break;
}
this.showEventEnd();
}
showEventStart() {
const eventIndicator = document.getElementById("eventIndicator");
const eventTitle = document.getElementById("eventTitle");
const eventTimer = document.getElementById("eventTimer");
eventTitle.textContent = `${this.data.emoji} ${this.data.name}`;
eventTitle.style.color = this.data.color;
eventIndicator.style.display = "flex";
eventIndicator.style.background = `linear-gradient(135deg, ${this.data.color}33, rgba(153, 102, 255, 0.7))`;
eventIndicator.style.borderColor = this.data.color;
showAdminAnnouncement(`🚀 Запущен ивент: ${this.data.name}`, this.data.color);
}
showEventEnd() {
showAdminAnnouncement(`⏰ Ивент "${this.data.name}" завершён`, "#aaaaaa");
}
getTimeLeft() {
return Math.max(0, this.endTime - Date.now());
}
getProgressPercent() {
const elapsed = Date.now() - this.startTime;
return Math.min(100, (elapsed / this.duration) * 100);
}
}
class Antidote {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.pos = new Vector(x, y);
        this.radius = 25;
        this.color = "#00ffff";
        this.pulse = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        this.glowPhase = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        this.rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        this.rotationSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.03;
        this.collected = false;
    }

    update(deltaTime) {
        this.pulse += deltaTime * CONFIG.ANTIDOTE.GLOW_SPEED;
        this.glowPhase += deltaTime * 0.1;
        this.rotation += this.rotationSpeed * deltaTime;

        // 1. Проверка сбора игроком
        if (player && player.isAlive && !gameOver && !player.isZombie) {
            const distToPlayer = this.pos.distance(player.pos);
            if (distToPlayer < this.radius + player.bodyPoints[0].radius) {
                this.collect(player);
                return false; // Убираем из массива антидотов
            }
        }

        // 2. Проверка сбора ботами (Мирные боты тоже собирают)
        // ВАЖНО: Зомби-боты не собирают антидоты (они их игнорируют)
        for (let bot of bots) {
            if (bot.isAlive && !bot.isZombie && !bot.isBanned) {
                const distToBot = this.pos.distance(bot.pos);
                if (distToBot < this.radius + bot.bodyPoints[0].radius) {
                    this.collect(bot);
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return !this.collected;
    }

    collect(collector) {
        if (this.collected) return;
        this.collected = true;

        // Увеличиваем счетчик
        antidotesCollected++;
        
        // ОБНОВЛЯЕМ UI (исправление проблемы с отображением)
        const counter = document.getElementById("antidoteCount");
        if (counter) {
            counter.textContent = antidotesCollected;
        }

        // Начисление очков
        score += 5;
// --- НОВАЯ МЕХАНИКА: СВЯТАЯ АУРА ---
        if (!collector.isZombie) {
            collector.holyAura = 4000; // 4 секунды защиты
            showAdminAnnouncement(`${collector.name} ПОЛУЧИЛ СВЯТУЮ АУРУ!`, "#00ffff");
        }

        // Эффекты частиц
        if (typeof GRAPHICS_SETTINGS !== 'undefined' && 
            GRAPHICS_SETTINGS[graphicsQuality.toUpperCase()].particles) {
            for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                particles.push(new Particle(this.pos.x, this.pos.y, "#00ffff"));
            }
        }

       // Проверка условия победы
        if (antidotesCollected >= CONFIG.ZOMBIE.ANTIDOTES_TO_WIN) {
            if (player && player.isZombie) {
                // Если ВЫ зомби, а люди собрали антидоты — ВЫ ПРОИГРАЛИ
                gameOver = true;
                document.body.classList.add('hide-mobile-controls'); 
                showHumanEscapeScreen();
            } else {
                // Если ВЫ человек и собрали антидоты — ВЫ ВЫИГРАЛИ
                showWinScreen();
            }
        }
        
        // Звук
        if (typeof playEatSound === 'function') {
            playEatSound();
        }
    }

    draw(ctx, camera) {
        if (this.collected) return;
        
        const screenPos = worldToScreen(this.pos, camera);
        const screenRadius = this.radius * camera.zoom;
        
        if (screenPos.x < -100 || screenPos.x > canvas.width + 100 || 
            screenPos.y < -100 || screenPos.y > canvas.height + 100) return;

        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(screenPos.x, screenPos.y);
        ctx.rotate(this.rotation);

        if (typeof GRAPHICS_SETTINGS !== 'undefined' && 
            GRAPHICS_SETTINGS[graphicsQuality.toUpperCase()].glow) {
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3 * (0.7 + Math.sin(this.glowPhase) * 0.3);
            ctx.fillStyle = "#00ffff";
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(0, 0, screenRadius * 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }

        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
        ctx.fillStyle = "#00ffff";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.rect(-screenRadius / 3, -screenRadius, screenRadius * 0.66, screenRadius * 2);
        ctx.rect(-screenRadius, -screenRadius / 3, screenRadius * 2, screenRadius * 0.66);
        ctx.fill();
        
        ctx.restore();
    }
} // КОНЕЦ КЛАССА Antidote

// ВЫНОСИМ ФУНКЦИЮ БОССА В ГЛОБАЛЬНУЮ ЗОНУ
function showBossWinScreen() {
    gameOver = true;
    document.body.classList.add('hide-mobile-controls');
    document.body.classList.add('is-dead');
    boss = null; 

    setTimeout(() => {
        const gameTimeSeconds = Math.floor((Date.now() - gameStartTime) / 1000);
        const minutes = Math.floor(gameTimeSeconds / 60);
        const seconds = gameTimeSeconds % 60;

        const ws = document.getElementById("winScreen");
        ws.style.display = "block";
        ws.querySelector("h2").textContent = "БОЖЕСТВО ПОВЕРЖЕНО! 🏆";
        ws.querySelector("h2").style.color = "#ffcc00";
        
        document.getElementById("winAntidotes").parentElement.innerHTML = `<span>Финальный счет:</span> <span>${score}</span>`;
        document.getElementById("winTime").textContent = `${minutes}:${seconds.toString().padStart(2, "0")}`;
        document.getElementById("winZombies").parentElement.style.display = "none";
        document.getElementById("winSurvivors").parentElement.style.display = "none";
    }, 1000);
}

   
class TrailParticle {
constructor(x, y, color) {
this.pos = new Vector(x, y);
this.color = color;
this.size = Math.random() * 3 + 2;
this.life = 1.0;
this.decay = 0.02 + Math.random() * 0.01;
this.alpha = 0.8;
}
update() {
this.life -= this.decay;
this.alpha = this.life * 0.8;
return this.life > 0;
}
draw(ctx, camera) {
const screenPos = worldToScreen(this.pos, camera);
ctx.save();
ctx.globalAlpha = this.alpha;
ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
ctx.beginPath();
ctx.arc(screenPos.x, screenPos.y, this.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.fill();
ctx.restore();
}
}
class TerritoryWar {
    constructor() {
        this.cellSize = CONFIG.TERRITORY_WAR.HEX_SIZE || 15;
        this.cols = Math.ceil(CONFIG.WORLD_SIZE / this.cellSize);
        this.rows = Math.ceil(CONFIG.WORLD_SIZE / this.cellSize);
        
        // Быстрый 1D массив
        this.flex = new Uint8Array(this.cols * this.rows);
        this.colors = [null, '#33cc66']; 
        
        this.playerTerritories = 0;
        this.totalTerritories = this.cols * this.rows;
        this.scorePerSecond = 0;
        this.lastScoreUpdate = Date.now();
        this.onOwnTerritory = false; // Флаг для буста
    }

    update(deltaTime) {
        if (!player || gameOver) return;

        const painters =[player, ...bots.filter(b => b.isAlive && !b.isBanned)];
        const now = Date.now();

        painters.forEach(worm => {
            const head = worm.bodyPoints[0].pos;
            const radius = (worm.bodyPoints[0].radius) + 2; 
            let colorId = worm.isPlayer ? 1 : 2;

            const startX = Math.floor((head.x - radius) / this.cellSize);
            const endX = Math.ceil((head.x + radius) / this.cellSize);
            const startY = Math.floor((head.y - radius) / this.cellSize);
            const endY = Math.ceil((head.y + radius) / this.cellSize);

            // Окрашивание под головой
            for (let x = startX; x <= endX; x++) {
                if (x < 0 || x >= this.cols) continue;
                for (let y = startY; y <= endY; y++) {
                    if (y < 0 || y >= this.rows) continue;

                    const cellCenterX = x * this.cellSize + this.cellSize / 2;
                    const cellCenterY = y * this.cellSize + this.cellSize / 2;
                    const dx = cellCenterX - head.x;
                    const dy = cellCenterY - head.y;
                    
                    if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= radius * radius) {
                        const index = x * this.rows + y;
                        if (this.flex[index] !== colorId) {
                            if (this.flex[index] === 1) this.playerTerritories--;
                            this.flex[index] = colorId;
                            if (colorId === 1) {
                                this.playerTerritories++;
                                score += 2; // Микро-очки за каждую соту
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // Замыкание кольца (раз в секунду во избежание лагов)
            if (!worm.lastFillTime || now - worm.lastFillTime > 1000) {
                let loopClosedIndex = -1;
                for (let i = 25; i < worm.bodyPoints.length; i += 3) {
                    if (head.distance(worm.bodyPoints[i].pos) < radius * 2.5) {
                        loopClosedIndex = i;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (loopClosedIndex !== -1) {
                    worm.lastFillTime = now;
                    this.fillPolygon(worm, loopClosedIndex, colorId);
                }
            }
        });

        // 🚀 НОВАЯ ИГРОВАЯ МЕХАНИКА: Бафф на своей территории
        const pHeadX = Math.floor(player.pos.x / this.cellSize);
        const pHeadY = Math.floor(player.pos.y / this.cellSize);
        if (pHeadX >= 0 && pHeadX < this.cols && pHeadY >= 0 && pHeadY < this.rows) {
            const pIndex = pHeadX * this.rows + pHeadY;
            if (this.flex[pIndex] === 1) {
                // Игрок на своей территории
                player.speedMultiplier = 1.3; // 30% ускорение
                player.mass += 0.2 * (deltaTime || 1); // Регенерация массы
                if (!this.onOwnTerritory) {
                    showAdminAnnouncement("⚡ ВЫ НА СВОЕЙ БАЗЕ! УСКОРЕНИЕ + ЛЕЧЕНИЕ!", "#33cc66");
                    this.onOwnTerritory = true;
                }
            } else {
                // Игрок вышел за территорию
                player.speedMultiplier = 1.0;
                this.onOwnTerritory = false;
            }
        }
    }

    fillPolygon(worm, loopEndIndex, colorId) {
        const poly =[];
        let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;

        for (let i = 0; i <= loopEndIndex; i++) {
            const p = worm.bodyPoints[i].pos;
            poly.push(p);
            if (p.x < minX) minX = p.x;
            if (p.x > maxX) maxX = p.x;
            if (p.y < minY) minY = p.y;
            if (p.y > maxY) maxY = p.y;
        }

        const startX = Math.max(0, Math.floor(minX / this.cellSize));
        const endX = Math.min(this.cols - 1, Math.ceil(maxX / this.cellSize));
        const startY = Math.max(0, Math.floor(minY / this.cellSize));
        const endY = Math.min(this.rows - 1, Math.ceil(maxY / this.cellSize));

        let cellsFilled = 0;

        for (let x = startX; x <= endX; x++) {
            for (let y = startY; y <= endY; y++) {
                const index = x * this.rows + y;
                if (this.flex[index] === colorId) continue;

                const cx = x * this.cellSize + this.cellSize / 2;
                const cy = y * this.cellSize + this.cellSize / 2;

                let inside = false;
                for (let i = 0, j = poly.length - 1; i < poly.length; j = i++) {
                    const xi = poly[i].x, yi = poly[i].y;
                    const xj = poly[j].x, yj = poly[j].y;
                    const intersect = ((yi > cy) != (yj > cy)) && (cx < (xj - xi) * (cy - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi);
                    if (intersect) inside = !inside;
                }

                if (inside) {
                    if (this.flex[index] === 1) this.playerTerritories--;
                    this.flex[index] = colorId;
                    if (colorId === 1) this.playerTerritories++;
                    cellsFilled++;
                }
            }
        }

        // 💥 НАГРАДА ЗА ЗАМЫКАНИЕ КОЛЬЦА
        if (colorId === 1 && cellsFilled > 15) {
            showAdminAnnouncement(`🔥 МЕГА-ЗАХВАТ: +${cellsFilled} КЛЕТОК!`, "#ffcc00");
            screenShake = 15;
            score += cellsFilled * 50;
            worm.mass += cellsFilled * 5; 
            // Эффект взрыва частиц
            if (typeof GRAPHICS_SETTINGS !== 'undefined' && GRAPHICS_SETTINGS[graphicsQuality.toUpperCase()].particles) {
                for (let k = 0; k < 30; k++) particles.push(new Particle(worm.pos.x, worm.pos.y, "#ffcc00"));
            }
        }
    }

    draw(ctx, camera) {
        // УЛЬТРА-ОПТИМИЗАЦИЯ: Отрисовываем ВСЕ квадраты одного цвета за один вызов (Batch Rendering)
        const left = Math.floor((camera.x - (canvas.width / 2) / camera.zoom) / this.cellSize) - 1;
        const right = Math.ceil((camera.x + (canvas.width / 2) / camera.zoom) / this.cellSize) + 1;
        const top = Math.floor((camera.y - (canvas.height / 2) / camera.zoom) / this.cellSize) - 1;
        const bottom = Math.ceil((camera.y + (canvas.height / 2) / camera.zoom) / this.cellSize) + 1;

        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.65; // Прозрачность зоны
        const drawSize = this.cellSize * camera.zoom + 1.2;

        // 1. Рисуем территорию игрока
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let x = Math.max(0, left); x <= Math.min(this.cols - 1, right); x++) {
            for (let y = Math.max(0, top); y <= Math.min(this.rows - 1, bottom); y++) {
                const index = x * this.rows + y;
                if (this.flex[index] === 1) {
                    const screenX = (x * this.cellSize - camera.x) * camera.zoom + canvas.width / 2;
                    const screenY = (y * this.cellSize - camera.y) * camera.zoom + canvas.height / 2;
                    ctx.rect(screenX, screenY, drawSize, drawSize);
                }
            }
        }
        
        let pColor = this.colors[1];
        if (player.skin === 'rainbow') pColor = getRainbowColor(Date.now() * 0.001);
        else if (typeof player.skin === 'string' && player.skin.startsWith('#')) pColor = player.skin;
        else if (Array.isArray(player.skin)) pColor = player.skin[0];
        else if (typeof player.skin === 'number') pColor = TEXTURE_GLOW_COLORS[player.skin] || this.colors[1];
        
        ctx.fillStyle = pColor;
        ctx.fill(); // ОДИН ВЫЗОВ НА ВЕСЬ ЭКРАН!

        // 2. Рисуем территорию ботов
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let x = Math.max(0, left); x <= Math.min(this.cols - 1, right); x++) {
            for (let y = Math.max(0, top); y <= Math.min(this.rows - 1, bottom); y++) {
                const index = x * this.rows + y;
                if (this.flex[index] === 2) {
                    const screenX = (x * this.cellSize - camera.x) * camera.zoom + canvas.width / 2;
                    const screenY = (y * this.cellSize - camera.y) * camera.zoom + canvas.height / 2;
                    ctx.rect(screenX, screenY, drawSize, drawSize);
                }
            }
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5555';
        ctx.fill();

        ctx.restore();
    }

    updateUI() {
        if (gameMode !== 'territory_war') return;
        const bar = document.getElementById('territoryProgressBarContainer');
        const fill = document.getElementById('territoryProgressFill');
        
        if (bar && fill) {
            bar.style.display = 'block';
            
            // Считаем процент и ограничиваем 0 - 100
            const percent = (this.playerTerritories / this.totalTerritories) * 100;
            const cleanPercent = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, percent));
            
            fill.style.width = cleanPercent + '%';
            fill.textContent = cleanPercent.toFixed(1) + '%';
            
            // Динамическая смена цвета бара
            if (cleanPercent >= 50) {
                fill.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg, #ff8800, #ffcc00)';
            } else {
                fill.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg, #118833, #33cc66)';
            }
        }
    }
}
class PolarityShift {
  constructor() {
this.magnets = [];
this.attractionCount = 0;
this.repulsionCount = 0;
this.neutralCount = 0;
this.lastPolaritySwitch = Date.now();
this.nextPolaritySwitch = Date.now() + CONFIG.POLARITY_SHIFT.POLARITY_SWITCH_TIME;
this.currentPolarity = 'neutral'; // 'attraction', 'repulsion', 'neutral'
this.polarityCycle = 0;
this.pulsePhase = 0;
this.playerPolarityEffect = 1.0;
this.botPolarityEffects = {};

this.initMagnets();
  }

  initMagnets() {
for (let i = 0; i < CONFIG.POLARITY_SHIFT.MAGNET_COUNT; i++) {
  const x = CONFIG.BORDER_SIZE + Math.random() * (CONFIG.WORLD_SIZE - CONFIG.BORDER_SIZE * 2);
  const y = CONFIG.BORDER_SIZE + Math.random() * (CONFIG.WORLD_SIZE - CONFIG.BORDER_SIZE * 2);
  
  // Начальная полярность распределяется случайно
  const polarityTypes = ['attraction', 'repulsion', 'neutral'];
  const polarity = polarityTypes[Math.floor(Math.random() * polarityTypes.length)];
  
  this.magnets.push({
x,
y,
polarity,
strength: CONFIG.POLARITY_SHIFT.MAGNET_STRENGTH * (0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4),
pulse: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
rotation: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
rotationSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02,
size: 15 + Math.random() * 10,
lastPolarityChange: Date.now()
  });
}

this.updateCounts();
console.log(`Polarity Shift: создано ${this.magnets.length} магнитных аномалий`);
  }

  update(deltaTime) {
this.pulsePhase += deltaTime * CONFIG.POLARITY_SHIFT.PULSE_SPEED;

// Обновляем пульсацию и вращение магнитов
this.magnets.forEach(magnet => {
  magnet.pulse += deltaTime * 0.05;
  magnet.rotation += magnet.rotationSpeed * deltaTime;
});

// Проверяем смену полярности
this.checkPolaritySwitch();

// Применяем эффекты магнитов к игроку и ботам
this.applyMagneticEffects(deltaTime);

// Обновляем счетчики
this.updateCounts();

// Обновляем эффект на игрока
this.updatePlayerEffect();

return true;
  }

  checkPolaritySwitch() {
const currentTime = Date.now();

if (currentTime >= this.nextPolaritySwitch) {
  this.switchPolarity();
  this.lastPolaritySwitch = currentTime;
  this.nextPolaritySwitch = currentTime + CONFIG.POLARITY_SHIFT.POLARITY_SWITCH_TIME;
  this.polarityCycle++;
}
  }

switchPolarity() {
    const polarities = ['attraction', 'repulsion', 'neutral'];
    let newPolarity;

    switch (this.currentPolarity) {
      case 'attraction': newPolarity = 'repulsion'; break;
      case 'repulsion': newPolarity = 'neutral'; break;
      case 'neutral': default: newPolarity = 'attraction'; break;
    }

    this.currentPolarity = newPolarity;

    const gc = document.getElementById('gameContainer');
    if (gc) {
        if (this.currentPolarity === 'repulsion') {
            gc.classList.add('polarity-rotated');
            showAdminAnnouncement("⚠️ МАГНИТНАЯ БУРЯ: МИР ПЕРЕВЕРНУТ!", "#ff00ff");
        } else {
            gc.classList.remove('polarity-rotated');
            if (this.currentPolarity === 'attraction') {
                showAdminAnnouncement("🧲 ПОЛЯРНОСТЬ НОРМАЛИЗОВАНА", "#00ffff");
            }
        }
    }

    // Обновляем магниты на карте
    this.magnets.forEach(magnet => {
      if (Math.random() < 0.4) {
        magnet.polarity = newPolarity;
        magnet.lastPolarityChange = Date.now();
      }
    });

    // 4. Текстовый анонс (теперь внутри метода)
    const polarityNames = {
      attraction: 'ПРИТЯЖЕНИЕ',
      repulsion: 'ОТТАЛКИВАНИЕ',
      neutral: 'НЕЙТРАЛЬНО'
    };

    showAdminAnnouncement(
      `🔁 СМЕНА ПОЛЯРНОСТИ: ${polarityNames[newPolarity]}`,
      this.getPolarityColor(newPolarity)
    );
  } // <--- Вот здесь теперь правильно закрывается функция
  applyMagneticEffects(deltaTime) {
if (!player || !player.isAlive) return;

// Эффекты на игрока
this.magnets.forEach(magnet => {
  const distance = player.pos.distance(new Vector(magnet.x, magnet.y));
  
  if (distance < CONFIG.POLARITY_SHIFT.EFFECT_RADIUS) {
const influence = 1 - (distance / CONFIG.POLARITY_SHIFT.EFFECT_RADIUS);

switch (magnet.polarity) {
  case 'attraction':
// Притягиваем игрока к магниту
const toMagnet = new Vector(magnet.x, magnet.y).sub(player.pos).normalize(); // Тут Ок, так как new Vector создается
const attractionForce = magnet.strength * influence * deltaTime * 20;
player.vel = player.vel.add(toMagnet.mul(attractionForce));
break;

  case 'repulsion':
// Отталкиваем игрока от магнита
const fromMagnet = player.pos.clone().sub(new Vector(magnet.x, magnet.y)).normalize();
const repulsionForce = magnet.strength * influence * deltaTime * 15;
player.vel = player.vel.add(fromMagnet.mul(repulsionForce));

// Наносим урон в зоне отталкивания
if (!adminPowers.godmode) {
  const damage = CONFIG.POLARITY_SHIFT.DAMAGE_IN_REPULSION * influence * deltaTime / 60;
  if (gameMode === 'boss') {
playerHealth -= damage;
playerHealth = Math.max(0, playerHealth);
  } else {
player.mass -= damage * 0.1;
player.mass = Math.max(CONFIG.PLAYER.INIT_MASS, player.mass);
  }
}
break;

  case 'neutral':
// Замедление в нейтральной зоне
player.vel = player.vel.mul(1 - influence * 0.3 * deltaTime);
break;
}
  }
});

// Эффекты на ботов
bots.forEach(bot => {
  if (!bot.isAlive || bot.isBanned || bot.isZombie) return;
  
  this.magnets.forEach(magnet => {
const distance = bot.pos.distance(new Vector(magnet.x, magnet.y));

if (distance < CONFIG.POLARITY_SHIFT.EFFECT_RADIUS) {
  const influence = 1 - (distance / CONFIG.POLARITY_SHIFT.EFFECT_RADIUS);
  
  switch (magnet.polarity) {
case 'attraction':
  const toMagnet = new Vector(magnet.x, magnet.y).sub(bot.pos).normalize();
  bot.vel = bot.vel.add(toMagnet.mul(magnet.strength * influence * deltaTime * 10));
  break;
  
case 'repulsion':
  // СТАЛО:
  const fromMagnet = bot.pos.clone().sub(new Vector(magnet.x, magnet.y)).normalize();
  bot.vel = bot.vel.add(fromMagnet.mul(magnet.strength * influence * deltaTime * 8));
  break;
  
case 'neutral':
  bot.vel = bot.vel.mul(1 - influence * 0.2 * deltaTime);
  break;
  }
}
  });
});
  }

  updatePlayerEffect() {
if (!player || !player.isAlive) return;

let speedMultiplier = 1.0;
let inAttractionZone = false;
let inRepulsionZone = false;
let inNeutralZone = false;

// Проверяем, в какой зоне находится игрок
this.magnets.forEach(magnet => {
  const distance = player.pos.distance(new Vector(magnet.x, magnet.y));
  
  if (distance < CONFIG.POLARITY_SHIFT.EFFECT_RADIUS) {
const influence = 1 - (distance / CONFIG.POLARITY_SHIFT.EFFECT_RADIUS);

switch (magnet.polarity) {
  case 'attraction':
inAttractionZone = true;
speedMultiplier *= 1 + (CONFIG.POLARITY_SHIFT.SPEED_BOOST_IN_ATTRACTION - 1) * influence;
break;
  case 'repulsion':
inRepulsionZone = true;
break;
  case 'neutral':
inNeutralZone = true;
speedMultiplier *= 1 - 0.5 * influence;
break;
}
  }
});

// Применяем эффект скорости
this.playerPolarityEffect = speedMultiplier;
player.speedMultiplier = speedMultiplier;

// Сохраняем информацию для UI
this.playerInAttraction = inAttractionZone;
this.playerInRepulsion = inRepulsionZone;
this.playerInNeutral = inNeutralZone;
  }

  updateCounts() {
this.attractionCount = this.magnets.filter(m => m.polarity === 'attraction').length;
this.repulsionCount = this.magnets.filter(m => m.polarity === 'repulsion').length;
this.neutralCount = this.magnets.filter(m => m.polarity === 'neutral').length;
  }

  getMagnetColor(magnet) {
switch (magnet.polarity) {
  case 'attraction':
return CONFIG.POLARITY_SHIFT.ATTRACTION_COLOR;
  case 'repulsion':
return CONFIG.POLARITY_SHIFT.REPULSION_COLOR;
  case 'neutral':
return CONFIG.POLARITY_SHIFT.NEUTRAL_COLOR;
  default:
return '#ffffff';
}
  }

  getPolarityColor(polarity) {
switch (polarity) {
  case 'attraction':
return CONFIG.POLARITY_SHIFT.ATTRACTION_COLOR;
  case 'repulsion':
return CONFIG.POLARITY_SHIFT.REPULSION_COLOR;
  case 'neutral':
return CONFIG.POLARITY_SHIFT.NEUTRAL_COLOR;
  default:
return '#ffffff';
}
  }

  draw(ctx, camera) {
this.magnets.forEach(magnet => {
  const screenPos = worldToScreen(new Vector(magnet.x, magnet.y), camera);
  const screenSize = magnet.size * camera.zoom;
  
  if (screenSize < 0.5) return;
  
  const color = this.getMagnetColor(magnet);
  const pulse = Math.sin(magnet.pulse) * 0.3 + 0.7;
  
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(screenPos.x, screenPos.y);
  ctx.rotate(magnet.rotation);
  
  // Внешнее свечение
  if (GRAPHICS_SETTINGS[graphicsQuality.toUpperCase()].glow) {
ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3 * pulse;
ctx.fillStyle = color;
for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
  const glowSize = screenSize * (1.5 + i * 0.5) * pulse;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, glowSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}
  }
  
  // Основной круг
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9 * pulse;
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, screenSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Внутренний круг
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, screenSize * 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Символ полярности
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = `bold ${screenSize * 0.8}px Arial`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  
  let symbol = '○';
  switch (magnet.polarity) {
case 'attraction':
  symbol = '↓';
  break;
case 'repulsion':
  symbol = '↑';
  break;
case 'neutral':
  symbol = '○';
  break;
  }
  
  ctx.fillText(symbol, 0, 0);
  
  // Радиус действия (только для ближайших магнитов)
  const distanceToPlayer = player ? player.pos.distance(new Vector(magnet.x, magnet.y)) : Infinity;
  if (distanceToPlayer < CONFIG.POLARITY_SHIFT.EFFECT_RADIUS * 2) {
ctx.globalAlpha = 0.1 * (1 - distanceToPlayer / (CONFIG.POLARITY_SHIFT.EFFECT_RADIUS * 2));
ctx.strokeStyle = color;
ctx.lineWidth = 2 * camera.zoom;
ctx.setLineDash([5 * camera.zoom, 3 * camera.zoom]);
ctx.beginPath();
const effectRadius = CONFIG.POLARITY_SHIFT.EFFECT_RADIUS * camera.zoom;
ctx.arc(0, 0, effectRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
ctx.stroke();
  }
  
  ctx.restore();
});

// Визуализация глобальной полярности
if (Date.now() - this.lastPolaritySwitch < 3000) {
  const alpha = Math.min(1, (3000 - (Date.now() - this.lastPolaritySwitch)) / 1000);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha * 0.1;
  ctx.fillStyle = this.getPolarityColor(this.currentPolarity);
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  ctx.restore();
}
  }

  updateUI() {
if (gameMode !== 'polarity_shift') return;

const polarityDisplay = document.getElementById('polarityDisplay');
polarityDisplay.style.display = 'block';

// Обновляем статистику
document.getElementById('attractionCount').textContent = this.attractionCount;
document.getElementById('repulsionCount').textContent = this.repulsionCount;
document.getElementById('neutralPolarityCount').textContent = this.neutralCount;

// Таймер до смены полярности
const timeUntilSwitch = Math.max(0, this.nextPolaritySwitch - Date.now());
document.getElementById('polaritySwitchTimer').textContent = 
  `${Math.ceil(timeUntilSwitch / 1000)}s`;

// Эффекты на игрока
document.getElementById('polaritySpeedEffect').textContent = 
  `x${this.playerPolarityEffect.toFixed(1)}`;

let effectText = i18n('Нет');
if (this.playerInAttraction) effectText = i18n('Притяжение') + ' ⬇️';
if (this.playerInRepulsion) effectText = i18n('Отталкивание') + ' ⬆️';
if (this.playerInNeutral) effectText = i18n('Замедление') + ' ⚪';
document.getElementById('currentPolarityEffect').textContent = effectText;

// Цвет фона в зависимости от глобальной полярности
const polarityNames = {
  attraction: 'ПРИТЯЖЕНИЕ',
  repulsion: 'ОТТАЛКИВАНИЕ',
  neutral: 'НЕЙТРАЛЬНО'
};

const title = document.querySelector('.polarity-title');
if (title) {
  title.textContent = `МАГНИТНЫЕ АНОМАЛИИ: ${polarityNames[this.currentPolarity]}`;
  title.style.color = this.getPolarityColor(this.currentPolarity);
}
  }
}
class Zombie {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.pos = new Vector(x, y);
        this.angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        this.size = 35;
        this.speed = 3.5; 
        this.isAlive = true;
        this.isZombie = true;
        this.dashTimer = 0;
        this.spitCooldown = Math.random() * 2000; // Кулдаун плевка
    }

    update(deltaTime) {
        let target = (player && player.isAlive && !player.isZombie && !gameOver) ? player : null;

        if (!this.dashTimer) this.dashTimer = Math.random() * 5000;
        this.dashTimer -= deltaTime * 16.6;
        
        let currentSpeed = this.speed;
        if (this.dashTimer <= 0) {
            currentSpeed = this.speed * 3.5; 
            if (this.dashTimer < -500) {
                this.dashTimer = 5000 + Math.random() * 3000;
            }
        }

        if (!target) {
            let minDist = Infinity;
            bots.forEach(bot => {
                if (bot.isAlive && !bot.isZombie && !bot.isBanned) {
                    const dist = this.pos.distance(bot.pos);
                    if (dist < minDist) { target = bot; minDist = dist; }
                }
            });

            const allWorms = [player, ...bots.filter(b => b.isAlive && !b.isBanned)];
            
            for (let i = 0; i < allWorms.length; i++) {
                let w1 = allWorms[i];
                if (!w1 || !w1.isAlive) continue;

                for (let j = i + 1; j < allWorms.length; j++) {
                    let w2 = allWorms[j];
                    if (!w2 || !w2.isAlive) continue;

                    if (w1.isZombie !== w2.isZombie) {
                        const dist = w1.pos.distance(w2.pos);
                        const r1 = w1.bodyPoints[0] ? w1.bodyPoints[0].radius : 15;
                        const r2 = w2.bodyPoints[0] ? w2.bodyPoints[0].radius : 15;
                        
                        if (dist < r1 + r2 + 10) {
                            let human = w1.isZombie ? w2 : w1;
                            
                            if (human.shieldTimer && human.shieldTimer > 0) continue;
                            if (human.isAdmin && adminPowers && adminPowers.godmode) continue;
                            if (human.spawnProtection && human.spawnProtection > 0) continue;

                            human.isZombie = true;
                            human.wasInfected = true;
                            human.skin = "#33ff33";
                            createCollisionEffect(human.pos.x, human.pos.y, "spark");
                            checkAllZombies();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (target) {
            const dx = target.pos.x - this.pos.x;
            const dy = target.pos.y - this.pos.y;
            const angleToTarget = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
            const distToTarget = this.pos.distance(target.pos);

            let delta = angleToTarget - this.angle;
            while (delta > Math.PI) delta -= Math.PI * 2;
            while (delta < -Math.PI) delta += Math.PI * 2;
            
            this.angle += delta * 0.15; 

            if (distToTarget < 60) {
                this.infect(target);
            }

            // ЛОГИКА СТРЕЛЬБЫ ПЛЕВКАМИ (Только если собрано >= 500 антидотов)
            if (antidotesCollected >= 500) {
                this.spitCooldown -= deltaTime * 16.6;
                if (this.spitCooldown <= 0 && distToTarget < 800) {
                    acidSpits.push(new AcidSpit(this.pos.x, this.pos.y, target.pos.x, target.pos.y));
                    this.spitCooldown = 2000 + Math.random() * 2000; // 2-4 секунды перезарядки
                }
            }
        }

        this.pos.x += Math.cos(this.angle) * currentSpeed;
        this.pos.y += Math.sin(this.angle) * currentSpeed;

        const center = new Vector(CONFIG.WORLD_SIZE / 2, CONFIG.WORLD_SIZE / 2);
        if (this.pos.distance(center) > CONFIG.MAP_RADIUS - 50) {
            this.angle = Math.atan2(center.y - this.pos.y, center.x - this.pos.x);
        }

        return this.isAlive;
    }

    infect(target) {
        if (target.isZombie || target.wasInfected) return;
        if (target.shieldTimer && target.shieldTimer > 0) {
            createCollisionEffect(target.pos.x, target.pos.y, "spark");
            return;
        }
        if (target.isAdmin && adminPowers && adminPowers.godmode) return; 

        target.isZombie = true;
        target.wasInfected = true;
        target.skin = "#33ff33";
        checkAllZombies();
    }

    draw(ctx, camera) {
        const screenPos = worldToScreen(this.pos, camera);
        const screenRadius = this.size * camera.zoom;
        
        if(screenPos.x < -100 || screenPos.x > window.innerWidth+100 || screenPos.y < -100 || screenPos.y > window.innerHeight+100) return;

        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(screenPos.x, screenPos.y);
        ctx.rotate(this.angle);

        const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.01) * 0.05;
        ctx.fillStyle = "#33ff33";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, 0, screenRadius * pulse, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        
        ctx.fillStyle = "black";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(screenRadius * 0.4, -screenRadius * 0.4, screenRadius * 0.25, 0, Math.PI*2);
        ctx.arc(screenRadius * 0.4, screenRadius * 0.4, screenRadius * 0.25, 0, Math.PI*2);
        ctx.fill();
        
        ctx.fillStyle = "red"; 
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(screenRadius * 0.5, -screenRadius * 0.4, screenRadius * 0.1, 0, Math.PI*2);
        ctx.arc(screenRadius * 0.5, screenRadius * 0.4, screenRadius * 0.1, 0, Math.PI*2);
        ctx.fill();
        
        ctx.restore();
    }
}
class Boss {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.pos = new Vector(x, y);
        this.vel = new Vector(0, 0);
        this.stage = 1;
        this.health = CONFIG.BOSS.HEALTH_STAGE_1;
        this.maxHealth = CONFIG.BOSS.HEALTH_STAGE_1;
        this.size = 60 * CONFIG.BOSS.SIZE_MULTIPLIER;
        
        this.behavior = 'CHASE'; // CHASE, BULLET_HELL, STUNNED
        this.stateTimer = 0;
        this.rotation = 0;
        this.isAlive = true;
        this.hue = 0; 
        
        this.stageHues =[0, 30, 60, 120, 180, 200, 280, 330, 0, 'rainbow']; // Красный, Оранжевый, Желтый и тд.
    }

    update(deltaTime) {
        if (!this.isAlive) return false;
        this.stateTimer += deltaTime * 16.6; // Время в мс

        // Переход стадий (каждые 10% хп)
        const hpPercent = (this.health / this.maxHealth) * 100;
        const targetStage = Math.min(10, 11 - Math.ceil(hpPercent / 10));
        if (targetStage > this.stage) this.setStage(targetStage);

        this.runAI(deltaTime);
        return this.isAlive;
    }

    setStage(s) {
        this.stage = s;
        this.size = (60 * CONFIG.BOSS.SIZE_MULTIPLIER) * (1 + s * 0.1);
        this.maxHealth += 2000; 
        this.health = this.maxHealth; 
        
        let currentHue = this.stageHues[s-1];
        this.hue = typeof currentHue === 'number' ? currentHue : 0;
        showAdminAnnouncement(`СТАДИЯ ${s}: Босс мутирует!`, this.stage === 10 ? "rainbow" : `hsl(${this.hue}, 100%, 50%)`);
    }

    runAI(deltaTime) {
        let toPlayer = (player && player.isAlive) ? player.pos.clone().sub(this.pos).normalize() : new Vector(0,0);

        switch (this.behavior) {
            case 'CHASE':
                this.rotation += 0.05;
                let speed = 2.0 + (this.stage * 0.2);
                this.vel.add(toPlayer.mul(0.2));
                this.vel.limit(speed);
                this.pos.add(this.vel);

                if (this.stateTimer > 4000) this.setBehavior('BULLET_HELL');
                break;

            case 'BULLET_HELL':
                this.vel.mul(0.8); // Тормозит
                this.pos.add(this.vel);
                this.rotation += 0.2; // Быстро крутится

                // Стреляет кольцом шаров
                if (Math.round(this.stateTimer) % 300 < 20) {
                    this.shootRing();
                }

                if (this.stateTimer > 3000) this.setBehavior('STUNNED');
                break;

            case 'STUNNED':
                this.vel.mul(0.5); // Останавливается
                this.pos.add(this.vel);
                // В этом состоянии он получает урон от тарана!
                if (this.stateTimer > 3000) this.setBehavior('CHASE');
                break;
        }
    }

    setBehavior(b) {
        this.behavior = b;
        this.stateTimer = 0;
        if (b === 'STUNNED') {
            showAdminAnnouncement("⚡ БОСС УЯЗВИМ! ТАРАНЬ ЕГО НА УСКОРЕНИИ!", "#00ffff");
        } else if (b === 'BULLET_HELL') {
            showAdminAnnouncement("⚠️ БЕРЕГИСЬ СНАРЯДОВ!", "#ff3333");
        }
    }

    shootRing() {
        screenShake = 5;
        let count = 8 + this.stage * 2;
        let color = this.stage === 10 ? "rainbow" : `hsl(${this.hue}, 100%, 50%)`;
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            let angle = (Math.PI * 2 / count) * i + this.rotation;
            let orb = new Orb(this.pos.x, this.pos.y, color, null, 1, "bot");
            orb.vel = new Vector(Math.cos(angle) * 8, Math.sin(angle) * 8);
            orb.isBossAttack = true; // Снаряд босса наносит урон при касании!
            orbs.push(orb);
        }
    }

    takeDamage(amount) {
        if (!this.isAlive) return;
        this.health -= amount;
        updateBossUI(this.health, this.maxHealth, this.stage);
        if (this.health <= 0) {
            this.isAlive = false;
            this.explode();
        }
    }

    explode() {
        screenShake = 100;
        for(let i=0; i<300; i++) particles.push(new Particle(this.pos.x, this.pos.y, "rainbow"));
        score += 50000;
        showAdminAnnouncement("БОЖЕСТВО ПОВЕРЖЕНО! ВЫ ЛЕГЕНДА!", "rainbow");
        if(typeof achievementStats !== 'undefined') achievementStats.bossKilled = true;
        checkAchievements();
        showBossWinScreen();
    }

    draw(ctx, camera) {
        const sPos = worldToScreen(this.pos, camera);
        const sSize = this.size * camera.zoom;
        
        // Цвет: красный если атакует, голубой если оглушен
        let renderColor = this.behavior === 'STUNNED' ? "#00ffff" : `hsl(${this.hue}, 100%, 50%)`;
        if (this.stage === 10 && this.behavior !== 'STUNNED') renderColor = getRainbowColor(Date.now()*0.001);

        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(sPos.x, sPos.y);
        ctx.rotate(this.rotation);

        // Аура
        const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, sSize * 2);
        grad.addColorStop(0, renderColor);
        grad.addColorStop(1, "transparent");
        ctx.fillStyle = grad;
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, sSize * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

        // Основное тело (Зубастая шестеренка)
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
        ctx.fillStyle = "#111";
        ctx.strokeStyle = renderColor;
        ctx.lineWidth = 5 * camera.zoom;
        
        ctx.beginPath();
        let spikes = 8 + this.stage;
        for (let i = 0; i < spikes * 2; i++) {
            let r = i % 2 === 0 ? sSize : sSize * 0.6;
            let a = (Math.PI * 2 / (spikes * 2)) * i;
            if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r);
            else ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r);
        }
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.stroke();

        // Ядро (Глаз)
        ctx.fillStyle = this.behavior === 'STUNNED' ? "#ffffff" : "#ff0000";
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, sSize * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

        ctx.restore();
    }
}
class BossMinion {
    constructor(x, y, boss) {
        this.pos = new Vector(x, y);
        this.boss = boss;
        this.size = 15;
        this.isAlive = true;
        this.angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    }

    update(deltaTime) {
        this.angle += 0.1;
        let orbitX = this.boss.pos.x + Math.cos(this.angle) * 250;
        let orbitY = this.boss.pos.y + Math.sin(this.angle) * 250;
        this.pos.x += (orbitX - this.pos.x) * 0.1;
        this.pos.y += (orbitY - this.pos.y) * 0.1;

        if (player && this.pos.distance(player.pos) < 150) {
            let toP = player.pos.clone().sub(this.pos).normalize().mul(8);
            this.pos.add(toP);
        }

        if (player && this.pos.distance(player.pos) < this.size + player.bodyPoints[0].radius) {
            if (!adminPowers.godmode) playerHealth -= 10;
            this.isAlive = false;
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    draw(ctx, camera) {
        const sPos = worldToScreen(this.pos, camera);
        ctx.fillStyle = `hsl(${this.boss.hue}, 100%, 70%)`;
        ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
        ctx.shadowColor = ctx.fillStyle;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(sPos.x, sPos.y, this.size * camera.zoom, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    }
}
class Orb {
    constructor(x, y, color, parentPoints, velocityMultiplier = 1, source = "bot", isGold = false) {
        this.anchorX = x;
        this.anchorY = y;
        this.pos = new Vector(x, y);
        
        // --- БЕЗОПАСНАЯ КОНВЕРТАЦИЯ ЦВЕТА ---
        let safeColor = color;
        if (Array.isArray(color)) safeColor = color[0];
        else if (typeof color === 'number') safeColor = TEXTURE_GLOW_COLORS[color] || "#ffffff";
        else if (color === 'admin' || color === 'PRIVILEGE_ADMIN') safeColor = "#ff0000";
        else if (color === 'CUSTOM') safeColor = typeof customColor !== 'undefined' ? customColor : "#ffffff";
        else if (color === 'REAL_DRAGON' || color === 'dragon_texture') safeColor = "#ff3333";
        else if (color === 'Dr23' || color === 'TEXTURE_SKIN') safeColor = "#33cc66";
        
        // Гарантируем, что this.color НИКОГДА не будет undefined
        this.color = isGold ? "#ffd700" : (safeColor || "#ffffff");
        this.source = source;
        this.isGold = isGold; // Флаг золотого орба
        
        if (source === "death") {
            this.vel = new Vector(0, 0); 
        } else {
            this.vel = new Vector(
                (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10 * velocityMultiplier,
                (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10 * velocityMultiplier
            );
        }

        this.deathTexture = null;
        this.imgRotation = 0;
        this.floatOffset = Math.random() * 100;

        if (source === "death" && typeof deathTextures !== 'undefined' && deathTextures.length > 0) {
            this.deathTexture = deathTextures[Math.floor(Math.random() * deathTextures.length)];
            this.imgRotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        } else {
            this.textureIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * (orbTextures.length || 7));
        }

        // Логика массы: если золотой, даем в 5 раз больше (базово 0.4 * 5 = 2.0)
        this.massValue = isGold ? 2.0 : 0.4;
       // Теперь золотой орб будет в 5-6 раз больше обычного
this.finalSize = isGold ? 120 : (16 + Math.random() * 10);
        this.renderRadius = 0;
        this.timeAlive = 0;
        this.attractionDelay = (source === "dropped") ? 800 : 200; 
        
        this.orbitAngle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        this.orbitRadius = isGold ? 10 : 5; // Золотой орб сильнее "плавает"
        this.rotationAngle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    }

    update(deltaTime) {
        this.timeAlive += deltaTime * 16.6;

        if (this.renderRadius < this.finalSize) {
            this.renderRadius += (this.finalSize - this.renderRadius) * 0.1 * deltaTime;
        }

        if (this.source === "death") {
            const time = Date.now() * 0.002 + this.floatOffset;
            this.pos.x = this.anchorX + Math.cos(time) * 3; 
            this.pos.y = this.anchorY + Math.sin(time * 1.3) * 3;
            if (!window.GAME_SETTINGS || window.GAME_SETTINGS.foodAnim !== false) this.imgRotation += 0.0005 * deltaTime;
        } else {
            if (!window.GAME_SETTINGS || window.GAME_SETTINGS.foodAnim !== false) {
                this.rotationAngle += 0.04 * deltaTime;
                this.orbitAngle += 0.02 * deltaTime;
            }
            
            this.pos.add(this.vel);
            this.vel.mul(0.92);

         let targetX = this.anchorX + Math.cos(this.orbitAngle) * this.orbitRadius;
            let targetY = this.anchorY + Math.sin(this.orbitAngle) * this.orbitRadius;
            
            this.pos.x += (targetX - this.pos.x) * 0.1;
            this.pos.y += (targetY - this.pos.y) * 0.1;
        }

        // ==========================================
        // НОВЫЙ БЛОК: УРОН ОТ СНАРЯДОВ БОССА
        // ==========================================
        if (this.isBossAttack && player && player.isAlive) {
            let distToPlayer = this.pos.distance(player.pos);
            if (distToPlayer < (player.bodyPoints[0].radius + 15)) {
                // Снаряд попал в игрока!
                if (!player.isAdmin || !adminPowers.godmode) {
                    playerHealth -= 10;
                    if (typeof updatePlayerHealthBar === 'function') updatePlayerHealthBar();
                    screenShake = 5;
                    // Вспышка красным
                    const flash = document.getElementById('screenFlash');
                    if(flash) { flash.style.backgroundColor = 'red'; flash.style.opacity = 0.3; setTimeout(()=>flash.style.opacity=0, 100); }
                    
                    if (playerHealth <= 0) killPlayer(player);
                }
                return false; // Удаляем снаряд после попадания
            }
        }
        // ==========================================

       if (player && player.isAlive && !gameOver && this.timeAlive > this.attractionDelay) {
            // Убеждаемся, что у игрока есть тело
            if (player.bodyPoints && player.bodyPoints.length > 0) {
                let dist = this.pos.distance(player.pos);
                let headRadius = player.bodyPoints[0].radius || 10;
                
let attractRange = this.isGold ? 400 : (CONFIG.ORBS.ATTRACTION_RANGE || 100);
// --- ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: ПРИМЕНЯЕМ ПРОКАЧКУ МАГНИТА И ПИТОМЦЕВ К ОРБАМ ---
if (player && player.isAlive && typeof rpgStats !== 'undefined') {
    let petBonus = window.activePetIcon ? 1.1 : 1.0;
    if (typeof petFedUntil !== 'undefined' && Date.now() < petFedUntil) petBonus = 1.5;
    attractRange *= (1 + (rpgStats.magnet * 0.3)) * petBonus; // Увеличиваем радиус
}

// ----------------------------------------------------
// 🚀 АДМИН-ФУНКЦИЯ: УСИЛЕННОЕ ПРИТЯЖЕНИЕ ОРБОВ
// ----------------------------------------------------
if (player && player.isAdmin && adminPowers.attractionMultiplier) {
    // Умножаем стандартный радиус на ползунок из админки
    attractRange *= adminPowers.attractionMultiplier; 
}

if (dist < attractRange + headRadius) {
                    let factor = dist / (attractRange + headRadius);
                    let toHead = player.pos.clone().sub(this.pos).normalize();
                    
                    let pullPower = (1 - factor) * (this.isGold ? 30 : 20) * deltaTime;
                    this.anchorX += toHead.x * pullPower;
                    this.anchorY += toHead.y * pullPower;

                    if (dist < headRadius + 15) {
                        if (gameMode === 'hunger') lastEatTime = Date.now();
                        
                        player.grow(this.massValue);
                        player.tongueTimer = 200; 
                        
                        // Безопасный вызов проглатывания
                        if (typeof player.swallow === 'function') {
                            player.swallow(this.finalSize);
                        }
                        
                        score += this.isGold ? 500 : 15;
                        
                        if (this.isGold) {
                            showAdminAnnouncement("✨ ВЫ НАШЛИ ЧИСТОЕ ЗОЛОТО! +500", "#ffd700");
                            screenShake = 10;
                            for(let i=0; i<20; i++) particles.push(new Particle(this.pos.x, this.pos.y, "#ffd700"));
                        }

                        if (typeof playEatSound === 'function') playEatSound();
                        return false; 
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

draw(ctx, camera) {
        // 🔴 ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: innerWidth / innerHeight
        const screenX = (this.pos.x - camera.x) * camera.zoom + window.innerWidth / 2;
        const screenY = (this.pos.y - camera.y) * camera.zoom + window.innerHeight / 2;

        if (screenX < -200 || screenX > window.innerWidth + 200 || 
            screenY < -200 || screenY > window.innerHeight + 200) return;

        const size = this.renderRadius * camera.zoom;
        const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.01 + this.orbitAngle) * 0.1;
        const drawSize = size * pulse;

        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(screenX, screenY);

        // ЛОГИКА ОТРИСОВКИ ЗОЛОТА
        if (this.isGold && goldOrbTexture.complete && goldOrbTexture.naturalWidth > 0) {
            ctx.rotate(this.rotationAngle);
            
            // ВЫКЛЮЧАЕМ ТЕНЬ И СВЕЧЕНИЕ НА ТЕЛЕФОНАХ!
            if (!isMobile || graphicsQuality !== "low") {
                ctx.shadowBlur = 30 * camera.zoom;
                ctx.shadowColor = "#ffd700";
                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
            }
            
            ctx.drawImage(goldOrbTexture, -drawSize, -drawSize, drawSize * 2, drawSize * 2);
        }
        else if (this.source === "death" && this.deathTexture) {
            ctx.rotate(this.imgRotation);
            ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "screen"; 
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95; 
            const dSize = drawSize * 3.5; 
            ctx.drawImage(this.deathTexture, -dSize/2, -dSize/2, dSize, dSize);
       } else {
            ctx.rotate(this.rotationAngle);
            let glowColor = this.color === 'rainbow' ? getRainbowColor(Date.now()*0.001) : this.color;
            if (glowColor === 'admin') glowColor = '#ff0000'; // ЗАЩИТА ОТ КРАША
            
            // 🔥 УЛЬТРА-ЗАЩИТА ОТ UNDEFINED (КРАША ИГРЫ) 🔥
            if (!glowColor || typeof glowColor !== 'string') {
                glowColor = '#ffffff'; // Если цвет сломался, делаем орб белым
            }
            
            // ОПТИМИЗАЦИЯ ДЛЯ IOS/СЛАБЫХ ПК: Отключаем тяжелые эффекты наложения
            if (!isMobile && graphicsQuality === "high") {
                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter"; 
                const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, drawSize * 2);
                grad.addColorStop(0, glowColor);
                grad.addColorStop(0.5, glowColor);
                grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
                
                ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(0, 0, drawSize * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            }

            const texture = orbTextures[this.textureIndex];
            if (texture && texture.complete && texture.naturalWidth > 0) {
                ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
                ctx.drawImage(texture, -drawSize, -drawSize, drawSize * 2, drawSize * 2);
            } else {
                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over"; // Сброс
                ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
                ctx.fillStyle = glowColor;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(0, 0, drawSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
                
                if (!isMobile || graphicsQuality === "high") {
                    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)";
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(0, 0, drawSize * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                }
            }
        }
        
        ctx.restore();
    }
}
class Food {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.anchorX = x;
        this.anchorY = y;
        this.pos = new Vector(x, y);
        this.targetRadius = 20 + Math.random() * 25; 
        this.currentRadius = 0; // Рост из нуля
        this.color = CONFIG.FOOD.COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * CONFIG.FOOD.COLORS.length)];
        this.value = CONFIG.FOOD.MASS_VALUE;
        this.textureIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * (orbTextures.length || 7));
        this.orbitAngle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        this.orbitRadius = 6 + Math.random() * 6;
        this.rotationAngle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    }

    update(deltaTime) {
       // Плавный рост
        if (this.currentRadius < this.targetRadius) {
            this.currentRadius += (this.targetRadius - this.currentRadius) * 0.08;
        }

        if (!window.GAME_SETTINGS || window.GAME_SETTINGS.foodAnim !== false) {
            this.rotationAngle += 0.04 * deltaTime;
            this.orbitAngle += 0.02 * deltaTime;
        }
        this.pos.x = this.anchorX + Math.cos(this.orbitAngle) * this.orbitRadius;
        this.pos.y = this.anchorY + Math.sin(this.orbitAngle) * this.orbitRadius;

        // Пылесос
        let target = null;
        let minDist = CONFIG.ORBS.ATTRACTION_RANGE;
        if (player && player.isAlive) {
            let d = this.pos.distance(player.pos);
            if (d < minDist) { minDist = d; target = player; }
        }
        bots.forEach(bot => {
            if (bot.isAlive && !bot.isBanned) {
                let d = this.pos.distance(bot.pos);
                if (d < minDist) { minDist = d; target = bot; }
            }
        });

        if (target) {
            let factor = minDist / CONFIG.ORBS.ATTRACTION_RANGE;
            let toHead = target.pos.clone().sub(this.pos).normalize();
            this.anchorX += toHead.x * (1 - factor) * 15 * deltaTime;
            this.anchorY += toHead.y * (1 - factor) * 15 * deltaTime;
        }
    }

   draw(ctx, camera) {
        // 🔴 ИСПРАВЛЕНИЕ: innerWidth / innerHeight
        const screenX = (this.pos.x - camera.x) * camera.zoom + window.innerWidth / 2;
        const screenY = (this.pos.y - camera.y) * camera.zoom + window.innerHeight / 2;
        
        // Быстрое отсечение
        if (screenX < -100 || screenX > window.innerWidth + 100 || screenY < -100 || screenY > window.innerHeight + 100) return;

        const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.005 + this.orbitAngle) * 0.15;
        const size = this.currentRadius * camera.zoom;
        const drawSize = size * pulse;
        
        const texture = orbTextures[this.textureIndex];
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(screenX, screenY);
        ctx.rotate(this.rotationAngle);

        
        if (GRAPHICS_SETTINGS[graphicsQuality.toUpperCase()].simpleFood) {
            // ДЛЯ МОБИЛОК: Просто рисуем кружок нужного цвета
            ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(0, 0, drawSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffffff";
            ctx.lineWidth = 2 * camera.zoom;
            ctx.stroke();
        } else {
            // ДЛЯ ПК (Высокая): Старый красивый рендер с аурой
            ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
            const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, drawSize * 1.8);
            grad.addColorStop(0, this.color);
            grad.addColorStop(0.4, this.color); 
            grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
            ctx.fillStyle = grad;
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, drawSize * 1.8, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

            if (texture && texture.complete && texture.naturalWidth !== 0) {
                ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
                ctx.drawImage(texture, -drawSize, -drawSize, drawSize * 2, drawSize * 2);
            } else {
                ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
                ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
                ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, drawSize, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
                ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)";
                ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, drawSize * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
            }
        }
        ctx.restore();
    }
}
function getRainbowColor(t, offset = 0) {
const hue = (t * 100 + offset * 10) % 360;
return `hsl(${hue}, 100%, 60%)`;
}
// ==================== ФУНКЦИИ ДЛЯ СИСТЕМЫ БАНОВ ====================

// Проверить аккаунт при входе
function checkAccountOnLogin(username) {
console.log("🔍 Проверяю аккаунт:", username);

if (!username || username === "") {
return true;
}

const user = username.toLowerCase();

// 1. Проверить БАН
if (ACCOUNT_SYSTEM.isBanned(user)) {
console.log("🚫 Аккаунт забанен!");
showBanScreen("🚫 ВАШ АККАУНТ ЗАБАНЕН", 
 "Аккаунт заблокирован навсегда", 
 "Забанен администратором");
return false;
}

// 2. Проверить ЗАМОРОЗКУ
if (ACCOUNT_SYSTEM.isFrozen(user)) {
console.log("❄️ Аккаунт заморожен!");
const freezeData = ACCOUNT_SYSTEM.freezes[user];

if (freezeData && freezeData.until) {
const endTime = freezeData.until;
const timeLeft = Math.max(0, endTime - Date.now());

const hours = Math.floor(timeLeft / (1000 * 60 * 60));
const minutes = Math.floor((timeLeft % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
const seconds = Math.floor((timeLeft % (60000)) / 1000);

showBanScreen("❄️ АККАУНТ ЗАМОРОЖЕН", 
 freezeData.reason || "Нарушение правил",
 `Разморозка через: ${hours}ч ${minutes}м ${seconds}с`);
} else {
showBanScreen("❄️ АККАУНТ ЗАМОРОЖЕН", 
 "Временная блокировка",
 "Обратитесь к администратору");
}
return false;
}

// 3. Проверить ПРЕДУПРЕЖДЕНИЯ
const warnings = ACCOUNT_SYSTEM.getWarnings(user);
if (warnings.length > 0) {
console.log("⚠️ У аккаунта есть предупреждения:", warnings.length);
// Можно показать всплывашку с предупреждениями
// alert(`У вас ${warnings.length} предупреждение(й):\n` + 
//   warnings.map(w => `• ${w.reason}`).join('\n'));
}

return true;
}

document.getElementById('loadingScreen').style.display = 'none';
document.getElementById('loginScreen').style.display = 'none';
document.getElementById('mainMenu').style.display = 'none';
document.getElementById('gameContainer').style.display = 'none';

banScreen.style.display = 'flex';

document.getElementById('banMessage').textContent = title;
document.getElementById('banReasonDisplay').textContent = "Причина: " + reason;
document.getElementById('banTime').textContent = timeInfo;

// Эффект
if (title.includes("БАН") || title.includes("ЗАБАНЕН")) {
banScreen.style.background = 'radial-gradient(circle, #220000 0%, #000000 100%)';

banScreen.style.background = 'radial-gradient(circle, #000022 0%, #000000 100%)';
}
}

class Particle {
constructor(x, y, color) {
this.pos = new Vector(x, y);
this.vel = new Vector(Math.random() * 3 - 1.5, Math.random() * 3 - 1.5);
this.color = color;
this.size = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
this.life = 1.0;
this.decay = 0.02 + Math.random() * 0.03;
this.rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
this.rotationSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.05;
}
update() {
this.pos = this.pos.add(this.vel);
this.vel = this.vel.mul(0.95);
this.life -= this.decay;
this.rotation += this.rotationSpeed;
return this.life > 0;
}
draw(ctx, camera) {
if (!GRAPHICS_SETTINGS[graphicsQuality.toUpperCase()].particles) return;

let screenPos;
if (gameMode === 'boss') {
    screenPos = this.pos;
} else {
    screenPos = worldToScreen(this.pos, camera);
}

const alpha = this.life;
ctx.save();
ctx.translate(screenPos.x, screenPos.y);
ctx.rotate(this.rotation);
ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
ctx.beginPath();
for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
const angle = (i * Math.PI) / 3;
const x = Math.cos(angle) * this.size;
const y = Math.sin(angle) * this.size;
if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
}
ctx.closePath();
ctx.fill();
ctx.restore();
}
}
// Вспомогательная функция для перевода HEX в RGB
function hexToRgb(hex) {
if (typeof hex !== 'string' || hex[0] !== '#') return { r: 255, g: 255, b: 255 }; // Возврат белого при ошибке
const bigint = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16);
return { r: (bigint >> 16) & 255, g: (bigint >> 8) & 255, b: 255 & 255 };
}
// Функция для 3D эффекта (тени и блики)
function adjustColor(color, p) {
    // Если пришло число (индекс текстуры), возвращаем стандартный цвет
    if (typeof color === 'number') return "#33cc66";
    // Если пришла не строка, тоже возвращаем стандарт
    if (typeof color !== 'string') return "#33cc66";

    // Игнорируем спец-команды
    if (color.includes('gradient') || color === 'rainbow' || color === 'admin') return color;
    
    // Если это HEX-цвет, пытаемся его изменить
    if (color.startsWith('#')) {
        try {
            const num = parseInt(color.replace("#", ""), 16);
            const amt = Math.round(2.55 * p);
            const R = (num >> 16) + amt;
            const G = (num >> 8 & 0x00FF) + amt;
            const B = (num & 0x0000FF) + amt;
            return "#" + (0x1000000 + (R < 255 ? (R < 1 ? 0 : R) : 255) * 0x10000 + (G < 255 ? (G < 1 ? 0 : G) : 255) * 0x100 + (B < 255 ? (B < 1 ? 0 : B) : 255)).toString(16).slice(1);
       } catch(e) {
            return "#33cc66";
        }
    }
    return color;
}

// 🚀 ЯДРО 2D-ПЛАТФОРМЕРА И БОСС "THE CURSED THORN" (V2 - УЛЬТРА-ДИНАМИКА)
// =========================================================================
let platProjectiles =[]; 
let bossProjectiles =[]; 
let bossDebris = []; // <--- НОВЫЙ МАССИВ ДЛЯ ОСКОЛКОВ
let platformerState = {
    floorY: 0,
    isInitialized: false,
    bgOffset: 0
};
class BossDebris {
    constructor(x, y, vx, vy, size, type, color) {
        this.x = x; this.y = y;
        this.vx = vx; this.vy = vy;
        this.size = size;
        this.type = type; // 'spike' или 'eye'
        this.color = color;
        this.rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        this.rotSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4;
    }
    update(dt) {
        this.vy += 0.6; // Гравитация тянет осколки вниз
        this.x += this.vx;
        this.y += this.vy;
        this.rotation += this.rotSpeed;
        return this.y < window.innerHeight + 200; // Исчезают далеко под картой
    }
    draw(ctx) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
        ctx.rotate(this.rotation);
        
        if (this.type === 'spike') {
            ctx.fillStyle = "#111";
            ctx.strokeStyle = this.color;
            ctx.lineWidth = 4;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(0, -this.size);
            ctx.lineTo(this.size * 0.6, this.size);
            ctx.lineTo(-this.size * 0.6, this.size);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.stroke();
        } else if (this.type === 'eye') {
            ctx.fillStyle = "#ff0000";
            ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
            ctx.shadowColor = "#ff0000";
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(0, 0, this.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.restore();
    }
}

class CursedThornBoss {
    constructor(x, y) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.baseY = y;
        this.maxHealth = CONFIG.BOSS.HEALTH_STAGE_1;
        this.health = this.maxHealth;
        
        // 📱 МАСШТАБИРОВАНИЕ БОССА
        const platScale = (typeof isMobile !== 'undefined' && isMobile) ? 0.6 : 1.0;
        this.size = 110 * platScale; 
        this.baseSize = this.size; // Запоминаем базовый размер для стадий
        
        this.isAlive = true;
        this.phase = 1;
        
        this.state = 'IDLE'; 
        this.stateTimer = 500;
        this.attackCooldown = 800;
        this.color = "#33ff33";
        this.flashTime = 0;
        this.hoverAngle = 0;
        this.rotation = 0;
        this.bodyPulse = 0; 
        
        this.lasers = []; 
        this.shotsFired = 0;

        this.trapMoveTimer = 0;
        this.trapTargetX = window.innerWidth / 2;
        this.spiritBombClicks = 0; 

        this.gasIntensity = 0; 
        this.gasDamageTaken = 0; 
    }
    
    update(dt) {
        if (!this.isAlive) return;

        const platScale = (typeof isMobile !== 'undefined' && isMobile) ? 0.6 : 1.0;

        if (this.state !== 'LASER_TRAP' && this.gasIntensity > 0) {
            this.gasIntensity = Math.max(0, this.gasIntensity - dt * 0.05);
        }

        if (this.state === 'DYING') {
            this.stateTimer -= 16;
            this.bodyPulse += 0.5;
            if (Math.random() < 0.4) {
                particles.push(new Particle(this.x + (Math.random()-0.5)*this.size, this.y + (Math.random()-0.5)*this.size, "#ff3300"));
            }
            if (this.stateTimer <= 0) this.explode(); 
            return; 
        }

        const hpPercent = this.health / this.maxHealth;
        const targetStage = Math.min(16, 17 - Math.ceil(hpPercent * 16));
        if (targetStage > this.phase) this.setStage(targetStage);

        const speedMult = 1.0 + (this.phase * 0.05);

        this.hoverAngle += 0.05 * speedMult; 
        this.rotation += 0.02 * speedMult;   
        this.bodyPulse += 0.1; 
        if (this.flashTime > 0) this.flashTime -= 16; 

        if (this.state === 'IDLE' || this.state === 'FIREBALL' || this.state === 'BOUNCE_ORB') {
            const targetX = player.pos.x;
            this.x += (targetX - this.x) * 0.015 * speedMult; 
            this.y = this.baseY + Math.sin(this.hoverAngle) * (40 * platScale);
        } else if (this.state === 'LASER_WARN' || this.state === 'LASER_SWEEP') {
            this.x += (window.innerWidth / 2 - this.x) * 0.05;
            this.y += ((150 * platScale) - this.y) * 0.1; 
        }

        this.x = Math.max(this.size, Math.min(window.innerWidth - this.size, this.x));
        this.stateTimer -= 16 * speedMult;
        
        if (this.state === 'IDLE' && this.stateTimer <= 0) {
            this.chooseAttack();
        } else if (this.state === 'FIREBALL') {
            if (this.stateTimer <= 0 && this.shotsFired < 5) {
                this.shootFireball(platScale);
                this.shotsFired++;
                this.stateTimer = 150; 
            } else if (this.shotsFired >= 5) {
                this.state = 'IDLE';
                this.stateTimer = this.attackCooldown;
            }
        } else if (this.state === 'BOUNCE_ORB') {
            if (this.stateTimer <= 0 && this.shotsFired < 1) {
                this.shootCatchOrb(platScale);
                this.shotsFired++;
                this.stateTimer = 500; 
            } else if (this.shotsFired >= 1) {
                this.state = 'IDLE';
                this.stateTimer = this.attackCooldown;
            }
        } else if (this.state === 'LASER_WARN') {
            if (this.stateTimer <= 0) {
                this.state = 'LASER_SWEEP';
                this.stateTimer = 2000;
            }
        } else if (this.state === 'LASER_SWEEP') {
            const progress = 1 - (this.stateTimer / 2000); 
            screenShake = 4; 
            
            this.lasers.forEach(laser => {
                laser.current = laser.start + (laser.target - laser.start) * progress;
                const laserWidth = 35 * platScale; 
                const dist = Math.abs(
                    Math.cos(laser.current) * (player.pos.y - this.y) - 
                    Math.sin(laser.current) * (player.pos.x - this.x)
                );
                const dotProduct = Math.cos(laser.current) * (player.pos.x - this.x) + 
                                   Math.sin(laser.current) * (player.pos.y - this.y);

                if (!player.isDying && dist < (laserWidth / 2 + player.size / 2) && dotProduct > 0) takePlatformerDamage(15); 
            });
            
            if (this.stateTimer <= 0) {
                if (this.lasers.length > 0 && this.lasers[0].type === 'trap') {
                    this.state = 'LASER_TRAP';
                    this.stateTimer = 30000; 
                    this.trapMoveTimer = 0;
                    showAdminAnnouncement("⚠️ ЛОВУШКА! ДЕРЖИСЬ В ЦЕНТРЕ 30 СЕКУНД!", "#ff0000");
                } else {
                    this.state = 'STUNNED';
                    this.stateTimer = 5000; 
                    this.spiritBombClicks = 0;
                }
            }
        } else if (this.state === 'LASER_TRAP') {
            screenShake = 2; 
            
            this.trapMoveTimer -= 16 * speedMult;
            if (this.trapMoveTimer <= 0) {
                this.trapTargetX = 200 + Math.random() * (window.innerWidth - 400); 
                this.trapMoveTimer = 2000 + Math.random() * 2000; 
            }
            this.x += (this.trapTargetX - this.x) * 0.005 * speedMult; 
            this.y += ((150 * platScale) - this.y) * 0.05;

            if (this.lasers.length >= 2) {
                const yDiff = player.pos.y - this.y;
                const bound1 = this.x + yDiff / Math.tan(this.lasers[0].current);
                const bound2 = this.x + yDiff / Math.tan(this.lasers[1].current);
                
                const safeLeft = Math.min(bound1, bound2);
                const safeRight = Math.max(bound1, bound2);

                if (player.pos.x < safeLeft || player.pos.x > safeRight) {
                    // Замедляем появление газа на мобилках (0.01 вместо 0.02)
const gasGrowSpeed = isMobile ? 0.01 : 0.02;
this.gasIntensity = Math.min(1.0, this.gasIntensity + (dt * gasGrowSpeed)); 

if (this.gasIntensity > 0.3 && !player.isDying) {
    if (!player.isAdmin || !adminPowers.godmode) {
        // Уменьшаем урон на мобилках (2 вместо 4)
        // На телефоне газ сносит 1.2 хп за тик (было 2). На ПК — 2.5 хп (было 4). 
// Игрок сможет дольше выживать, если не успел убежать в безопасную зону.
const dmg = isMobile ? 1.2 : 2.5;
                            playerHealth -= dmg;
                            this.gasDamageTaken += dmg;
                            updatePlayerHealthBar();
                            if (playerHealth <= 0) takePlatformerDamage(999); 
                        }
                        if (Math.random() < 0.3) screenShake = 8;
                    }
                } else {
                    this.gasIntensity = Math.max(0.0, this.gasIntensity - (dt * 0.05));
                    if (this.gasDamageTaken > 0 && playerHealth < CONFIG.PLAYER.HEALTH && !player.isDying) {
                        const heal = 10 * (dt / 16); 
                        const actualHeal = Math.min(heal, this.gasDamageTaken);
                        if (playerHealth + actualHeal <= CONFIG.PLAYER.HEALTH) playerHealth += actualHeal;
                        else playerHealth = CONFIG.PLAYER.HEALTH;
                        this.gasDamageTaken -= actualHeal;
                        updatePlayerHealthBar();
                    }
                }
            }

            this.lasers.forEach(laser => {
                laser.current = laser.target; 
                const laserWidth = 35 * platScale; 
                const dist = Math.abs(Math.cos(laser.current) * (player.pos.y - this.y) - Math.sin(laser.current) * (player.pos.x - this.x));
                const dotProduct = Math.cos(laser.current) * (player.pos.x - this.x) + Math.sin(laser.current) * (player.pos.y - this.y);
                if (!player.isDying && dist < (laserWidth / 2 + player.size / 2) && dotProduct > 0) takePlatformerDamage(15); 
            });

            if (this.stateTimer <= 0) {
                this.state = 'STUNNED';
                this.stateTimer = 5000; 
                this.spiritBombClicks = 0;
            }
        } else if (this.state === 'STUNNED') {
            this.vel = new Vector(0,0);
            if (this.stateTimer <= 0) {
                this.launchSpiritBomb(platScale); 
                this.state = 'IDLE';
                this.stateTimer = this.attackCooldown;
            }
        }
        updateBossUI(this.health, this.maxHealth, this.phase);
    }

    setStage(s) {
        this.phase = s;
        const platScale = (typeof isMobile !== 'undefined' && isMobile) ? 0.6 : 1.0;
        this.size = this.baseSize + (s * 2 * platScale); 
        this.hue = (s * 22.5) % 360; 
        this.color = `hsl(${this.hue}, 100%, 50%)`;
        showAdminAnnouncement(`СТАДИЯ ${s}/16: Босс мутирует!`, this.color);
    }

   chooseAttack() {
        const rand = Math.random();
        const extremeMode = this.phase >= 14; // Экстрим мод на 14-16 стадиях
        
        if (rand < 0.60) { this.state = 'FIREBALL'; } 
        else if (rand < 0.85) { 
            this.state = 'LASER_WARN';
            this.stateTimer = extremeMode ? 600 : 1500; // На экстриме времени на реакцию почти нет
            this.lasers = [];
            const laserType = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
            if (laserType === 0) {
                const startR = player.pos.x > window.innerWidth/2 ? Math.PI*0.35 : Math.PI*0.65;
                const endR = player.pos.x > window.innerWidth/2 ? Math.PI*0.65 : Math.PI*0.35;
                this.lasers.push({ start: startR, target: endR, current: startR, type: 'single' });
                if (extremeMode) { // Двойной перекрестный лазер на экстриме
                    this.lasers.push({ start: endR, target: startR, current: endR, type: 'single' });
                }
            } else if (laserType === 1) {
                this.lasers.push({ start: Math.PI/2, target: Math.PI*0.25, current: Math.PI/2, type: 'split' }); 
                this.lasers.push({ start: Math.PI/2, target: Math.PI*0.75, current: Math.PI/2, type: 'split' });
            } else {
                const trapGap = isMobile ? 0.55 : 0.35; 
                this.lasers.push({ start: Math.PI * 0.05, target: Math.PI / 2 - trapGap, current: Math.PI * 0.05, type: 'trap' }); 
                this.lasers.push({ start: Math.PI * 0.95, target: Math.PI / 2 + trapGap, current: Math.PI * 0.95, type: 'trap' }); 
            }
        } else { 
            this.state = 'BOUNCE_ORB'; 
        }
        this.shotsFired = 0;
        this.stateTimer = 0;
    }

    shootFireball(platScale) {
        bossProjectiles.push({
            type: 'fireball',
            x: this.x, y: this.y + this.size/2,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10 * platScale, 
            vy: (5 + Math.random() * 5) * platScale, 
            radius: 20 * platScale, color: "#ff2222",
            trail:[]
        });
    }

    shootCatchOrb(platScale) {
        const dx = player.pos.x - this.x;
        const timeToReach = 60; 
        bossProjectiles.push({
            type: 'bounce',
            x: this.x, y: this.y + this.size/2,
            vx: dx / timeToReach, 
            vy: -3 * Math.sqrt(platScale), 
            radius: 40 * platScale, color: "#33ff33", 
            homing: false, 
            trail:[]
        });
        showAdminAnnouncement("🟢 ПОЙМАЙ ЗЕЛЕНУЮ СФЕРУ, ПОКА ОНА НЕ УПАЛА!", "#33ff33");
    }

    launchSpiritBomb(platScale) {
        if (this.spiritBombClicks > 0) {
            // Теперь каждый тап (клик) наносит 5000 урона вместо 2500. Игрок сможет снести кучу ХП!
            const damage = this.spiritBombClicks * 5000;
            const radius = Math.min(150, 30 + this.spiritBombClicks * 3) * platScale;
            platProjectiles.push({
                x: player.pos.x, y: player.pos.y - (120 * platScale),
                targetX: this.x, targetY: this.y,
                radius: radius,
                damage: damage,
                color: "#9966ff"
            });
            this.spiritBombClicks = 0;
        }
    }

    takeDamage(amount) {
        if (!this.isAlive || this.state === 'DYING') return; 
        this.health -= amount;
        this.flashTime = 100; 
        if (this.health <= 0) {
            this.health = 0;
            this.state = 'DYING'; 
            this.stateTimer = 2500; 
            showAdminAnnouncement("КРИТИЧЕСКОЕ ПОВРЕЖДЕНИЕ ЯДРА!", "#ff0000");
        }
        updateBossUI(this.health, this.maxHealth, this.phase);
    }

    explode() {
        this.isAlive = false; 
        screenShake = 120; 
        const flash = document.getElementById('screenFlash');
        if(flash) { flash.style.backgroundColor = '#ffffff'; flash.style.opacity = 1; setTimeout(()=>flash.style.opacity=0, 1000); }

        const platScale = (typeof isMobile !== 'undefined' && isMobile) ? 0.6 : 1.0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            let angle = (Math.PI * 2 / 12) * i;
            let speed = (15 + Math.random() * 15) * platScale; 
            let vx = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
            let vy = Math.sin(angle) * speed - (10 * platScale); 
            bossDebris.push(new BossDebris(this.x, this.y, vx, vy, this.size * 0.4, 'spike', this.color));
        }

        bossDebris.push(new BossDebris(this.x, this.y, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10 * platScale, -25 * platScale, this.size * 0.4, 'eye', null));

        for(let i=0; i<300; i++) {
            particles.push(new Particle(this.x, this.y, i % 2 === 0 ? "#ff0000" : "#ffaa00"));
            particles.push(new Particle(this.x, this.y, "#ffffff"));
        }

       score += 500000;
        myCoins += 2500; // Даем 2500 монет за победу
        if (typeof saveCloudDataYandex === 'function') saveCloudDataYandex();
